A famous '''Corellian smuggler''' once had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a head, and was tracked by a tenacious [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Credit Case Surprise)|bounty hunter]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] managed to escape the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] by rigging a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] case with a powerful [[Spotlight/Legends|spotlight]] that emitted a blinding light when opened. The idea led to an entrepreneur creating the "[[Credit Case Surprise]]."<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology" />
